+    context.set_ciphers.assert_called_once_with('CIPHER-A:CIPHER-B')
+    assert context.verify_mode == ssl.CERT_REQUIRED
+
+    context.options = 0
+    urls.make_context(ciphers='CIPHER-A', validate_certs=False)
+    if ssl.OP_NO_SSLv2:
+        assert context.options & ssl.OP_NO_SSLv2
+    assert context.options & ssl.OP_NO_SSLv3
+    assert context.verify_mode == ssl.CERT_NONE
+

+    assert paths_checked == [cafile]
